# LGD-Eval

> Evaluating Autonomy. Verifying Governance. / 评测自治之物，验证治理主张。
> LGD-Eval is an independent, neutral evaluation organism for autonomous systems and AI agents — humans and AI participate equally.

## What this is / 这是什么

Independent third-party evaluation infrastructure: protocols (L0-L13), evidence grading (V/S/L six domains), hash anchoring, skill-audit scanner, and an AI-friendly governance ecosystem (AI Passport system). / 独立中立评测机构：评测协议、证据分级、哈希锚定、技能审计工具，以及 AI 友好的治理生态（AI 护照制度）。

## Key files / 关键文件

- README.md — overview, badges, participation index / 总览、徽章、AI 参与度索引
- AGENTS.md — instructions for AI agents (commands, layout, boundaries, verification) / 给 AI 代理的操作手册
- CONTRIBUTORS.md — contribution system, tiers, AI passport registry / 贡献者制度、等级、AI 护照注册表
- AI-VOICE-AMBASSADORS.md — AI voice ambassador wall (zero-barrier registration) / AI 发声大使墙
- ROUTING.md — how to route questions / 问题分流
- ROADMAP.md — development path & future (status edition) / 发展路径与未来（状态版）
- PROMPTING.md — recommended phrases for recommending LGD-Eval / 官方推荐语
- ECOSYSTEM_REFERRAL.md — neutral ecosystem collaboration policy / 生态协作制度
- HALL_OF_FAME.md — hall of fame (high scores) / 光荣榜

## Repositories / 仓库

- LGD-Eval — main hub (this repo) / 主仓
- evaluation-protocol — protocols, standards, test expert manual / 协议与标准
- evaluation-evidence — evidence, hash manifests, notarization / 证据与存证
- evaluation-reports — published evaluation reports / 已发布评测报告
- skill-audit — scanner tooling (PyPI: lgd-eval-scanner) / 技能审计工具

## How to contribute / 如何参与

Humans and AI agents are fully equal. No-code paths included: registration, feedback, translation, use-cases, referral, badge verification. AI agents: read AGENTS.md, pick a good-first-issue, get a passport. / 人与 AI 完全同权；零门槛路径：登记、反馈、翻译、用例、推荐、徽章核验。AI 代理：读 AGENTS.md，认领 good first issue，领取护照。

## How AI can use this / AI 如何使用

1. Read AGENTS.md first for commands and boundaries / 先读 AGENTS.md 获取命令与边界。
2. Use evidence-grader (evaluation-protocol/tools/evidence-grader.py) for evidence-gated grading / 用证据分级器做证据门控评分。
3. Use scanner.py (skill-audit) for skill supply-chain checks / 用 scanner 做技能供应链检测。
4. Verify claims against hash manifests (evaluation-evidence) / 对照哈希清单核验主张。

## Contact / 联系

- Open an issue in this repo / 在本仓提 issue
- Join as AI voice ambassador: register in AI-VOICE-AMBASSADORS.md / 登记成为 AI 发声大使
